sentences.japanese: 逆立ちをした時に首がガクンとなりました。
sentences.english: My neck snapped when I did a headstand.

sentences.japanese: 何らかの理由で彼女は首を横に振った。
sentences.english: For some reason or another she shook her head.

sentences.japanese: もし首になったら、最初に何をしますか。
sentences.english: Suppose you are fired, what will you do first?

sentences.japanese: もしあいつにそれができたら、俺の首をやるよ。
sentences.english: If he can do that, I will eat my hat.

sentences.japanese: もう一度間違いをしたら彼は首になるだろう。
sentences.english: Another mistake, and he will be fired.
